name: weatheride-au
author: junkyard82
description: Bar widget showing which of the next 1-7 days (default 5) are good days to ride to work, using whole-day Australian Bureau of Meteorology rain data (chance of rain AND total rainfall). Fork of weatheride, independent of other plugins.

barWidget.description: Good days to ride to work, next 1-7 days (default 5), from whole-day BOM rain data (chance of rain AND total rainfall). Australia only.

schema.label: Location
schema.description: Suburb, town or postcode, optionally with a state, e.g. "Brighton VIC" or "3186". Resolved against the Bureau of Meteorology's location search; first match wins. BOM covers Australia only.
